verdicts.reason: Both use the same weak leaderboard layout. The logo is jammed against the headline at the left edge, and the SAVE 15% badge floats on its own above the body copy. The coffee bag is shrunk to a tiny sliver that is cut off at the right edge, so the key product image is lost, and the small body copy has weak contrast. A's badge sticks out past the right edge of the body copy and its button is shorter. B's wider button is a slightly stronger CTA and its badge lines up a little better, but the difference is marginal.
